mentions.name: Better Taste
mentions.description: This iOS app helps travelers find handpicked places with real local character across European cities — cafés, restaurants, and hidden galleries — with no sponsored listings or aggregator noise.
mentions.problem: Travel discovery is cluttered by sponsored listings and aggregator noise, making it hard to find places with genuine local character.
mentions.audience: travelers looking for authentic places in European cities
mentions.source_excerpt: Building an iOS app that helps travelers find handpicked places with real local character: cafés, restaurants, hidden galleries across European cities. No sponsored listings, no aggregator noise.
